title: elymus arenarius var. sabulosus
intro: Elymus arenarius var. sabulosus, commonly known as beach wildrye, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is native to coastal areas in Europe and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Elymus arenarius var. sabulosus include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs, sore throats, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
